title: Marlon Wayans, Tahiry Jose, Erbo In The Morning, And Laz Alonso All React To Wild Story Involving Four Fired Tennessee Cops
htmlContent:
A Tennessee police force fired five policemen and suspended three others after wild allegations of sexual escapades, including a "Girls Gone Wild" party in a jacuzzi.

A La Vergne policewoman who claimed to be in "an open marriage" was charged with sordid behavior, including oral sex at headquarters and a threesome.

“This situation is unacceptable, and as soon as it was brought to our attention, it was immediately investigated, and action was taken upon the individuals involved,” Cole said in a statement. “Our top priority moving forward will include rebuilding the public’s trust. I have full confidence in the police department’s leadership team and their ability to lead the department. We will be retraining all of our employees in the rules, regulations, and expectations set forth by city leadership.”

The department opened an internal investigation last month into alleged endemic sexual escapades and multiple unreported dates involving a female officer, identified as Maeghan Hall, and several colleagues, according to the nydailynews.

The four men fired were Patrolman Juan Lugo Perez, Sergeant Lewis Powell, Detective Seneca Shields and Sergeant Henry Ty McGowan. The K-9 Officer Larry Holladay, Patrol Officer Patrick Magliocco and Patrol Officer Gavin Schoeberl were reportedly suspended.

The internal investigation, released on December 28, found that the appointments took place at the agents' homes, hotels and parties. One encounter was allegedly carried out during a booze-fueled hot tub party where Hall reportedly took off her top at one officer’s house that included family members of the officers. Hall is also accused of engaging in a threesome with Magliocco and his wife.'

Magliocco admitted to sleeping with Hall on "numerous occasions," and accused her of also bragging about her co-worker Powell’s "big Black d***." 

"This is a difficult situation for our department and for the city, but I want to be clear that the actions of a few do not represent this department as a whole," Chief Burrel "Chip" Davis said.

"This situation is being addressed internally with our staff, we are bringing in counselors to help our officers work through these circumstances, and we will continue to provide the most professional protection as possible for this community."

When Hollywood Unlocked shared the news to their Instagram they received a lot of comments in the comment section, Including from Marlon Wayans, Ebro from Ebro in the Morning, Tahiry Jose, and actor Laz Alonso are reacted.

"I got next," said Wayans. "They was reenacting porn.., " said Ebro.

Jose added, "Well damnnnn Maegan."

Finally added, "Meagan was wildin!!!!"
